integrity: The proof is self-contained, uses exact analytic inequalities and explicit near-extremizers, does not rely on numerical evidence for an infinite-dimensional assertion, and makes no claim of independently audited validation.
scientific_limitations: Only finite input exponents strictly greater than one, positive fixed multiplicative window ratios, and the exactly scale-critical target exponent are covered. Norms are unpowered even in the quasi-Banach target. The qualitative noncompactness argument for the symmetric case and the general tail-localisation principle are present in the cited focal source; exact sharp constants and the stated full-parameter quantitative profile are the contribution.
title: Exact norms and flat approximation numbers for scale-critical Hardy–Steklov windows
